data.current_description:
Returns the latest version of one or more documents by ID, without the delay of the query index. It is less scalable than the Query API, so use it only when you need the most recent write.

The endpoint accepts only the query parameters listed here. Any other parameter, including `perspective`, returns a `400` error.
data.summary_suggestion: Retrieve latest document versions by ID
data.description_suggestion:
Fetches the latest version of one or more documents by their IDs, bypassing the query index cache for real-time access. Use this endpoint when you need the most current document state, though it is less scalable than the Query API.

Authentication: Requests to public datasets don't require a token and return only published documents. To access drafts, release versions, or documents in private datasets, provide a bearer token with read access. Documents the token cannot access are omitted from the response with reason `permission`.

Input: Accepts only the documented query parameters. Passing undocumented parameters (including `perspective`) returns a 400 error.

Output: Returns documents matching the request criteria. Inaccessible documents are listed in the `omitted` field with their IDs and access reason.
